## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Roadmap and ownership

- [ ] Linked the owning roadmap task, or explained why the change is outside the roadmap.
- [ ] Updated roadmap checkboxes only when implementation and acceptance criteria are complete.
- [ ] Updated capability status, evidence, limitations, and ownership when public behavior changed.

## Architecture and compatibility

- [ ] Added or updated an ADR when changing a platform boundary, durable contract, or security model, or marked this not applicable with rationale.
- [ ] Added a migration guide for every incompatible public API or durable-format change, or marked this not applicable.
- [ ] Updated release notes for user-visible or operator-visible behavior, or marked this not applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] Added focused tests, including fail-closed and tenant-boundary coverage where applicable.
- [ ] Ran the affected tests and repository policy checks.
- [ ] Updated conceptual and API documentation where applicable.
